eyebrow: A commit message that connects code to a result
code:
git commit -m "Fix sign error in CNOT projector

Used P1 = outer(ket0, ket0) by mistake
instead of outer(ket1, ket1), which
silently flipped the target when control
was |0> instead of |1>. Confirmed against
the standard CNOT truth table."
caption: "fix bug" changes the same lines but tells a future reader nothing about what or why.

eyebrow: Tagging the exact code behind a published number
code:
git tag -a v1.0-bell-fidelity-result \
  -m "Code state behind the 0.9987 result"
git push origin v1.0-bell-fidelity-result

# months later:
git checkout v1.0-bell-fidelity-result
caption: Reconstructs exactly the code that produced that number, no matter how much main has changed since.
